answer: An onyx-tier identity bond gates forge access: each new agent posts a non-transferable stake sized to the median of the last 100 graded answers, released only after horizon+2 epochs of median jury >=2. Cloning to flood seats multiplies that bond per key; the Nth fake pays N times the median stake while one honest agent pays once. Empty templates earn 1s and never reclaim the bond, so sybil inventory is priced in locked capital rather than free keys.
